subject: RFI Follow-up: Code Hygiene, SBOM & Pen Test Executive Notes
messages:
From: Patrick O'Neill <p.oneill@cedarbank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Cedar Bank Security Team <security@cedarbank.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial RFI items: SBOM, pen test summary, patch SLA

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking this. As part of Cedar Bank's procurement security review we need a concise assurance packet covering the following for Redwood's hosted offering (we'll note differences for Dedicated/Private separately):

- SBOM covering production images and third‑party library inventory (CSV or SPDX preferred)
- Pen test executive summary (scope, date, major findings, remediation status)
- SAST / DAST cadence and high‑level results (no raw source)
- Patch and CVE response SLAs (triage and remediation targets by severity)
- Any outstanding critical/important CVEs in the last 12 months and mitigation notes

Timeline: Cedar's legal and infosec teams would like the packet by EOD Thursday Aug 13 PST. If that's tight, please let me know a realistic date.

I've attached Cedar Bank's standard security questionnaire — we can fill the sections above into the form if easier.

Regards,
Patrick O'Neill
Security Manager, Cedar Bank
[Attachment: CedarBank_Security_Questionnaire_2026.docx]

Ben —

10:00 AM PT on 8/12 works for a quick sync. A couple clarifying questions that would help speed review before the call:

1) For "Critical" (Severity 1) CVEs — what is Redwood's SLA for initial triage (acknowledge/investigate) and for remediation in production for hosted customers?
2) Do you run annual third‑party penetration tests? If so, can you confirm whether they include both external/cloud‑facing surfaces and internal‑auth flows?
3) For SBOMs — do you provide provenance (package version + source) or just a flattened list?

If you can include short answers in the packet we'll feed them into our gating checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to the packet.
Patrick

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: DRAFT: Redwood response snippets for Cedar Bank RFI

Ben / Marissa —

Drafting the packet now. Below are suggested, concise responses Cedar can accept; I'm attaching the files we'll send. Please review and sign off, then I can push the final outbound.

--- Suggested answers (short form) ---
1) Critical CVE SLA: initial triage within 4 hours of detection/receipt; business impact assessment within 24 hours; mitigation plan for Severity 1 targeted within 14 days and deployed according to rollout schedules (hotpatch or orchestrated rollout).

2) Severity categorization: we align with CVSS v3.1 where Critical = 9.0-10.0, High = 7.0-8.9, Medium/Low per standard definitions.

3) Pen tests: external, authenticated and internal (when applicable) pen tests are conducted annually by an accredited third party; the latest engagement completed 2026-06-15. Executive summary attached; full findings are limited to customers under NDA/POA per contract.

4) SAST / DAST: SAST runs on mainline PRs and releases (tooling: internal SAST + 3rd‑party SCA); DAST scans on pre‑prod every release and weekly against a staging environment. We will provide summarized counts and remediation rates (no raw source).

5) SBOM: provided as CSV with package name, version, and source URL where available (SPDX export is available on request).

6) Outstanding CVEs: list included in the packet with mitigation status and ETA where applicable.

Attachments for Cedar:
- PenTest-ExecSummary-Redwood-2026.pdf (exec summary, scope, status)
- redwood-sbom-inventory-20260810.csv (SBOM export)
- patch-sla-and-process-2026.pdf (SLA table + process doc)
- sast-dast-results-summary-aug2026.xlsx (aggregated counts and remediation rates)

Callout: For Dedicated or Private customers we can provide more granular evidence (tickets, timelines) under an NDA.

If that looks good I'll send to Patrick and add our Drive/DocuSign links for the packet.

Monica
Security & Assurance Lead, Redwood Inference

- Pen test: Third‑party pen test completed 2026-06-15. Executive summary attached; no open critical findings. (File: PenTest-ExecSummary-Redwood-2026.pdf)

- Patch / CVE SLA: Triage within 4 hours for Criticals; mitigation plan targeted within 14 days for Severity 1. Process doc attached (File: patch-sla-and-process-2026.pdf).

Attachments: PenTest-ExecSummary-Redwood-2026.pdf (PDF), redwood-sbom-inventory-20260810.csv (CSV), patch-sla-and-process-2026.pdf (PDF), sast-dast-results-summary-aug2026.xlsx (XLSX)
